shared_elements: carved/incised relief on weathered grey stone
dense small carved marks or bosses
justification: Both are weathered stone surfaces bearing shallow incised relief organised in broadly horizontal bands, and each includes a distinct circular/disc element, which is about the limit of the correspondence. The overwhelming difference is that A is a flat rectangular slab wholly covered by a dense, uniform grid of tiny repeated sign-like marks, whereas B is a three-dimensional anthropomorphic sculpture with a few large, sparse curvilinear motifs following the contours of a body.
